meta.title: Right to Vote (illustrative demo)
meta.description: Simplified, illustrative example loosely modeled on Swedish election law (rösträtt). Not verified legal advice or a complete rule set — for testing this prototype only.

attributes.label: Registered resident in a Swedish municipality?

Q1.question: 18 years old or older?
Q1.supportiveText: Voters must be at least 18 years old.

Q2.question: Which election?
Q2.supportiveText: National and municipal elections have different citizenship rules.

Q3.question: Swedish citizen?
Q3.supportiveText: Only Swedish citizens may vote in national elections in this simplified model.

Q4.question: Swedish citizen?
Q4.supportiveText: Swedish citizens may always vote in municipal elections.

Q5.question: Registered resident in a Swedish municipality?
Q5.supportiveText: Non-Swedish citizens may vote in municipal elections if registered as a resident, in this simplified model.

OUT_CannotVote.label: Cannot vote
OUT_CannotVote.description: The person is not eligible to vote under these facts (simplified model).

OUT_CanVoteNational.label: Can vote (national election)
OUT_CanVoteNational.description: The person may vote in the national election under these facts (simplified model).

OUT_CanVoteMunicipal.label: Can vote (municipal election)
OUT_CanVoteMunicipal.description: The person may vote in the municipal election under these facts (simplified model).
